Sub: Review of proposals for grant of exemption from EDLI Scheme 1976 and
extension thereof under Section 17(2A) of EPF & MP Act, 1952 — reg.

Ref: (i) Co-ord.2 (2)2002/Amend./Pt./4827 dated 14th June 2005.
(ii) No, CPFC/Exem/SZ/2005 Vol.IN/4 4750 dated 21-10-2007.
(iii) No. CPFC/Exem/SZ/2005 Vol.1/1947 dated 23-5-2008
(iv) CPFC fetter No.CPFC/Exemp/SZ/Vol.1/2005/47860 dated 26-03-2009.

Sir,

Your kind attention is invited to Headuarters circular dated 14" June 2005 regarding
revised procedure for processing applications for seeking grant of exemption from EDLI
Scheme, 1976 u/s 17(12A) of the EPF & MP Act, 1952 followed by a further letter dated
26.03.2009 impressing upon all the Addl. CPFCs to conduct a general review in respect of
establishments in the Regions under their jurisdiction which are due for grant of extension
of exemption and send their reports to Headquarters. However, it is regretted to note that
the situation has not improved in many zones namely, the office (s) of Addi. CPFC (PB &
HP), Addl. CPFC (UP & BR), Addl. CPFC(HR &Ru), Addl. CPFC(WB, NE, JH) and Addl.
CPFC(MH & CHT). The Addl. CPFCs in the states are again advised to accord due
attention to the matter and conduct a general review in respect of establishments in the
Regions under their jurisdiction and identify the proposals which were due for further
extension and the fresh proposals for grant of exemption. It is further informed that during
the current financial year, all the proposals received till September 2009 have been
accorded sanction under Section 17(2A) of the Act and communicated to the Addl. CPFCs.
Henceforth, the proposals may be monitored regularly and Headquarters may also be
informed of the status of their notification in the Official Gazette. All Addl. CPFCs are
requested to send their report upto the quarter ending September 2009 to Headquarters in
the enclosed proforma by 20.10.2009 and henceforth similar reports may be sent on the
close of subsequent quarter.

Youfs faithfully,

ann
